description: Mortgage Interest Deduction Limit — Deductible home mortgage interest when loans exceed the $750,000 / $1,000,000 limits (IRS Publication 936 Table 1). Required: interest (USD paid this year) and at least one average balance: post_2017 (acquisition debt after Dec 15 2017), pre_2017 (Oct 14 1987 - Dec 15 2017), grandfathered (before Oct 14 1987), other_debt (home equity not used to buy, build or improve). Optional: filing (single|mfj|mfs; MFS limits halved). Returns the full worksheet, qualified loan limit, deductible and nondeductible interest, verdict FULLY_DEDUCTIBLE/PARTIALLY_DEDUCTIBLE/NOT_DEDUCTIBLE. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_mortgage_interest_limit
